title: CLOSURE_SNAPSHOT_TOCTOU_CHILD_MUTATION_NOT_COVERED_BY_ERA_CAS
mechanism: closeEra calls buildEraArchiveSnapshot before opening its closure transaction.
buildEraArchiveSnapshot reads Era child rows outside the closure transaction.
closeEra later compares only eras.updated_at against the snapshot builder's eraUpdatedAt.
A product/media/section/membership/watchtower child mutation can commit without changing eras.updated_at.
The closure transaction can therefore persist a stale snapshot and still transition the Era to CLOSED.
consequence: The CLOSURE snapshot is not guaranteed to represent a transactionally consistent state at closure. This can create historical evidence that is already stale before the CLOSED transition commits.

remainsValid: production/shared implementations are imported and exercised by the R1 harness
future-start ACTIVE/PUBLIC/primary is rejected by resolveCurrentPublicEra
archive requires a persisted CLOSURE snapshot
TypeScript and reported regression suites passed
notEstablished: closure snapshot atomicity against concurrent child-row mutation

fc01Disposition: The original FC-01 substitution/future-start false-positive class was not reproduced after remediation, but the remediation candidate is still FAIL due to new material FRC-01.
